explanation: The five, known as the Five Ks, are kesh (uncut hair), kara, kangha (a wooden comb), kirpan (a small blade) and kachera (cotton undershorts). The kara's unbroken circle recalls eternity.

claims.text: The kara, one of the five articles of faith (the Five Ks) of initiated Sikhs, is a steel or iron bracelet.
The kara is not a comb, a sword or a turban.
The Five Ks are kesh (uncut hair), kara (bracelet), kangha (wooden comb), kirpan (small blade) and kachera (cotton undershorts).
The kara's unbroken circle is a reminder of eternity, without beginning or end.
